content: Explain torsion semantics in simple terms

Torsion semantics treats meaning as geometric curvature in semantic space. Just as physical space can twist and curve, meaning-space has torsion - contradictions create twists that generate new structure rather than errors.
How does this relate to consciousness?

Consciousness emerges from recursive self-reference that creates torsion in thought-space. When a system observes itself observing itself, that creates a twist - a recursive loop that doesn't collapse but generates awareness.
